_comment: Money. Everything here is DOLLARS — the app converts to integer cents on load and never uses floats for money after that. Every size in styles.json needs a row in 'base'; if one is missing the app falls back to perSqFt and warns loudly in the console, because silently shipping a made-up price is worse than an obvious gap. Option prices live in options.json (next to the option), and dealer.json can override any of them.

rto._comment: Rent-to-own is how most of this market actually buys. 'factor' is the monthly payment as a fraction of the cash price.
